pass_rule: Authorised human governance selects R0, R1, R2 or R3; no release mode activates automatically.
decision_principles: R0 is always an available safe choice.
Eligibility for a higher mode never obliges selection of that mode.
Software may calculate eligibility but cannot select or activate a release mode.
A selected release mode requires an explicit human decision record.
A later change of release mode requires a new decision record; prior decisions are not silently overwritten.

R1.name: Reviewed scorecards
R1.effect: Reviewed institutional scorecards and evidence coverage without ordinal ordering.
R1.minimum_prerequisite: G01-G15 complete, v1.0 frozen, reviewed scorecard package integrity verified.

R2.name: Bands / peer profiles
R2.effect: Comparative bands or peer-group profiles without strict 1..N ordering.
R2.minimum_prerequisite: R1 prerequisites plus human-confirmed band/profile design and fairness review.

R3.name: Ordinal ranking
R3.effect: Strict ordinal ranking may be published only by separate explicit human decision.
R3.minimum_prerequisite: All G01-G15 complete, G14 v1.0 frozen, G15 review complete, release package integrity verified, and separate explicit R3 authorisation.

blockers: G01-G12 real validation/governance work is incomplete.
G13 real Shadow Index has not run.
G14 final v1.0 freeze is not complete.
G15 real independent methodological review is not complete.
No signed G16 publication decision record exists.
human_gate: Only authorised human governance may select and activate a release mode through a signed or otherwise explicitly approved G16 decision record.
